comment: Curated feed catalog, verified end to end with `rssfeeds check`. The fulltext field records what the feed itself ships: full (>=4000 chars of body text), partial (800-3999), teaser (<800). Teaser and partial feeds rely on the extractor to fetch the article body; feeds where the summary IS the content (arXiv, bioRxiv) set "extract": false. The unavailable list records sources checked and found unusable, so the work is not repeated. The priority field (1 filler, 2 normal, 3 must-read) is the editorial weight used when an issue has less room than there is material; unrated feeds count as normal. Editions are named, right-sized issues with their own sources, lookback window and reading-time budget.

editions.title: Deep Work
editions.description: Only sources that build durable models or skills. No announcements, no news, nothing perishable. This is the edition to read if you read only one.

editions.title: Local Brief
editions.description: New Hampshire and Amherst: zoning, schools, town meeting, weather. Perishable but actionable. World news is deliberately excluded — it is current-awareness, not improvement.

editions.title: Long Reads
editions.description: The weekly sit-down: essays, science writing and analysis that keeps. Announcements and news are excluded by kind, not merely ranked lower.

editions.title: World Skim
editions.description: Current-awareness in one bounded sitting, so it cannot expand to fill the week.
